items.exampleEn: The two neighbors stopped talking because of a petty argument about a fence.
items.exampleZh: 那兩個鄰居為了圍籬的小事吵了一架，從此不再說話。

items.exampleEn: She has an astonishing memory for names and faces.
items.exampleZh: 她記人名和長相的能力驚人。

items.exampleEn: In a moment of madness, I bought a coat I didn't need.
items.exampleZh: 一時瘋狂，我買了一件根本不需要的外套。

items.exampleEn: He insulted the waiter, so the manager asked him to leave.
items.exampleZh: 他侮辱服務生，所以經理請他離開。

items.exampleEn: The respected newspaper apologized for the mistake.
items.exampleZh: 那家受人敬重的報社為錯誤道歉。

items.exampleEn: The children watched the magician with fascination.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們著迷地看著魔術師。

items.exampleEn: The weary travelers fell asleep as soon as the train left.
items.exampleZh: 疲倦的旅客們在火車一開動就睡著了。

items.exampleEn: After the exam, I indulged myself with a whole day of video games.
items.exampleZh: 考完試後，我盡情地玩了一整天的電玩。

items.sentenceEn: Let's not waste time on petty details when the deadline is tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 截止日期就在明天，我們別把時間浪費在瑣碎的細節上。

items.audioEn: I'm weary of these long meetings; can we keep them under an hour?
items.audioZh: 我厭倦了這些冗長的會議，我們能不能控制在一小時以內？
options: Meetings that are under an hour

items.sentenceEn: It is astonishing how fast children learn new languages.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子學新語言的速度快得令人驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: He felt insulted when nobody listened to his idea.
items.sentenceZh: 沒人聽他的意見時，他覺得受到侮辱。

items.stemEn: Paying that much money for a pair of shoes is pure ____.
items.stemZh: 花那麼多錢買一雙鞋，根本是瘋了。

items.stemEn: Once in a while, it's fine to ____ in a long afternoon nap.
items.stemZh: 偶爾盡情睡個長長的午覺也無妨。

items.passageEn: Professor Chang is one of the most respected historians in the country. His fascination with old maps began when he was a child. Many colleagues think it is madness to spend so many years on one collection, but the results have been astonishing. Last month, he discovered a map that showed a forgotten island. Some critics insulted his work, calling it a petty hobby, but he ignored them. Even when he feels weary after long days in the library, he invariably keeps going. On weekends, he indulges in his only other pleasure: fishing with his grandchildren.
items.passageZh: 張教授是國內最受尊敬的歷史學家之一。他從小就對古地圖很著迷。許多同事覺得花那麼多年研究同一批收藏簡直是瘋了，但成果令人驚嘆。上個月，他發現一張標出一座被遺忘島嶼的地圖。有些評論家侮辱他的研究，說那只是瑣碎的嗜好，但他不予理會。即使在圖書館待了一整天、覺得很疲倦，他也總是繼續研究。週末時，他會盡情享受他唯一的另一項樂趣：和孫子去釣魚。

questions.questionZh: 張教授上個月發現了什麼？
options: 海邊一座古城留下的遺跡
一本古代船長親手寫的航海日記
標出被遺忘島嶼的地圖
一枚古代留下的稀有硬幣

questions.questionZh: 週末時張教授會做什麼？

items.promptZh: 她是這個領域裡很受尊敬的專家。
referenceEn: She is a highly respected expert in this field.
She is a very respected expert in this area.
rubricZh: respected 表示「受尊敬的」（例如 a respected expert；is highly respected 也正確）

items.instructionZh: 用 fascination 造一個句子，說說你從小就著迷的事物。
referenceEn: My fascination with space started when I was a child.
I have always had a fascination with old cars.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 fascination（例如 a fascination with／for… 等）
